A4_S3_D1: ^Narrator: Clara leads you through the dense trees and into a clearing. Nestled in the clearing is a homestead overlooking a sunlit meadow.
^Narrator: A meandering river heels the farm, shaded by trees. As you take in your surroundings, you notice dozens of cotton balls bouncing around, seemingly with a will of their own…
^Clara: In a way, they’re both. They're small but they're vital to our survival on this island. I love them to bits, even if they can be a handful.
^Clara: It used to be me and my mentor, Ada, but now it's just me!
^Narrator: One of the woolly critters is happily circling Clara’s feet.
^Clara: As you can see, they’re covered in a cotton-like, woolly coat, which we harvest to spin into textiles.
^Clara: It ends up growing back, so it doesnt hurt them at all!
^Noelle: (What can they make, I wonder…? Is it the same as the cotton plants from Dusk?)
^Noelle: How do you make these textiles?
^Clara: You know, I’m not sure exactly… That’s Rowan’s job — our head craftsman!
^Clara: You’ll meet him soon enough. Some of the arrivals from Noah's time specialised in making fine textiles. So they've adapted their customs to work with the resources here!
^Amelia: That includes the tapestries from the Viridi village, right? We saw a few of them.
^Clara: Yup, yup! Since you seem to be interested in them, would you like to help me shear their coats?
choiceanytips: ^Clara: Sometimes petting them can help to calm them down. Like this.
^Narrator: Clara demonstrates a circular patting motion.
choiceletsdoit: ^Narrator: You try to grab the closest creature to you. It immediately wriggles out of your arms and bounces away.
^Clara: Oh! They can be pretty mischievous, especially with strangers.
afterchoiceact4: ^Narrator: As soon as you begin patting the creature’s soft head, it stops trying to escape your arms. Clara passes you the shears and you relieve the cute critter of some of its wool.
^Clara: You got it! Let’s do five more each.
